taskTemplate.name: Pull Deed
taskTemplate.description: Pull the current deed from the applicable registry of deeds and complete the ownership screen

subTaskTemplate.name: Pull Deed from Registry
subTaskTemplate.description: Pull Deed from Registry – Pull the current recorded deed from the applicable registry of deeds for the subject property and save to eFolder.
subTaskTemplate.type: Pull Deed – Pull Deed from Registry

subTaskTemplate.name: Ownership Screen
subTaskTemplate.description: Title – Complete the Title to the property Will be Held in What Name(s)? and For Refinance: Title to the Property is Currently Held in What Name(s)? fields. (should be same for HELOC)

subTaskTemplate.name: Trust
subTaskTemplate.description: Trust – If held in a trust, check off Title Will be Held by an Inter Vivos (Living) Trust).

subTaskTemplate.name: Add Non-Borrowing Owner
subTaskTemplate.description: Add Non-Borrowing Owner – If an owner on the deed is not a borrower on the loan, add them to the file contacts as a non-borrowing owner.
